description: Brisco pursues John Bly's gang across a frontier being transformed by new inventions, while the mysterious Orb repeatedly turns a straightforward revenge hunt into something much stranger.

s01e01-02.description: After John Bly's gang murders his marshal father, Brisco is hired to hunt the escaped outlaws and finds the strange Orb already entangled with the chase.

s01e03.description: Brisco and Bowler track Bly to Poker Flats, where an old acquaintance and a scholar studying the Orb complicate the hunt.

s01e04.description: The Swill brothers steal an experimental Army tank and menace a town run entirely by women, drawing Brisco and Bowler into its defense.

s01e05.description: Brisco and Socrates cross into Mexico to recover stolen guns and discover Pete Hutter trying to sell them to a corrupt general.

s01e06.description: Socrates' visiting sister becomes involved in Brisco's latest pursuit, forcing him to balance family complications with another dangerous bounty.

s01e07.description: Brisco takes to a riverboat where gambling, criminals and a valuable cargo turn the journey into a moving trap.

s01e08.description: Brisco and Bowler encounter a band of modern-day pirates whose operation brings old-fashioned robbery into conflict with new technology.

s01e09.description: A case involving an elderly frontier legend forces Brisco to separate heroic reputation from the more complicated man behind it.

s01e10.description: Brisco puts his Harvard legal training to work when a case forces him into the courtroom rather than another straightforward bounty hunt.

s01e11.description: Brisco returns to a town tied to his past and faces a showdown where old relationships matter as much as quick reflexes.

s01e12.description: Dixie becomes the center of a dangerous scheme and Brisco must navigate both her performance world and the criminals closing in around her.

s01e13.description: A pair of formidable sisters and a valuable crystal draw Brisco and Bowler into a pursuit where alliances shift faster than the quarry.

s01e14.description: The arrival of motorcycles gives Brisco a glimpse of the coming century while a gang learns to use the new machines for crime.

s01e15.description: Brisco and Bowler investigate a scheme exploiting women arriving in the West as mail-order brides and uncover the criminals behind it.

s01e16.description: Brisco operates under another identity in Kansas while tracking a case that forces him to hide who he really is.

s01e17.description: A gathering of professional bounty hunters becomes dangerous when rivalries, reputations and a valuable target converge in one place.

s01e18.description: Stories of a fountain of youth lead Brisco toward another apparent miracle whose real value attracts people willing to kill for it.

s01e19.description: Brisco enters a rough mining town where local power and a hard-edged young ally complicate his pursuit of the latest outlaw.

s01e20.description: Brisco and Bowler escort two orphaned children across California to claim an inheritance while enemies try to stop them reaching it.

s01e21.description: Brisco finally confronts John Bly as a visitor from the future reveals the Orb's origin and the true scale of Bly's plan.

s01e22.description: Brisco races to stop outlaw Ned Zed from robbing a newly opened bank while the frontier's changing technology again alters the contest.

s01e23.description: Brisco escorts a spy toward the Mexican border in exchange for an American agent, turning a stagecoach journey into an international operation.

s01e24.description: Brisco and Bowler head to Reno when a crime family threatens Dixie's sister and attempts to seize control of her nightclub.

s01e25.description: Brisco, Bowler and Dixie protect an infant revealed to be heir to the Chinese throne from assassins who intend to rule through him.

s01e26.description: Socrates is kidnapped on his birthday by a man believed to have died years earlier, leaving Brisco to untangle revenge from apparent supernatural menace.

s01e27.description: Brisco and Bowler are framed for high treason and condemned by the cavalry, forcing them to uncover the conspiracy before their execution.

s01e28.description: After escaping a staged death, Brisco and Bowler hunt the rogue general behind the treason plot while his posse closes in on them.
